    function toggleAccordion(trigger) {
      const item = trigger.closest('.accordion-item');
      const isActive = item.classList.contains('active');

      // Close all
      document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.remove('active');
        el.querySelector('.accordion-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 1;

    function slideNews(direction) {
      const cards = newsTrack.querySelectorAll('.news-card');
      const perView = getCardsPerView();
      const maxIndex = cards.length - perView;

      newsIndex += direction;
      if (newsIndex < 0) newsIndex = maxIndex;
      if (newsIndex > maxIndex) newsIndex = 0;

      const cardWidth = cards[0].offsetWidth + 24; // 24 = gap
      newsTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${newsIndex * cardWidth}px)`;

      const amount = custom || (selected ? selected.dataset.amount : null);

    function animateCounters() {
      const counters = document.querySelectorAll('[data-target]');
      counters.forEach(counter => {
        if (counter.dataset.animated) return;
        const target = parseInt(counter.dataset.target);
        const suffix = counter.dataset.suffix || '';
        const prefix = counter.dataset.prefix || '';
        const duration = 2000;
        const startTime = performance.now();

        function update(currentTime) {
          const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
          const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
          // Ease out cubic
          const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
          const current = Math.round(eased * target);
          counter.textContent = prefix + current.toLocaleString() + suffix;
          if (progress < 1) {
            requestAnimationFrame(update);
          } else {
            counter.dataset.animated = 'true';
          }
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(update);
      });
    }

    // Intersection Observer for counter animation
    const impactSection = document.getElementById('impact');
    const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCounters();
          counterObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    if (impactSection) {
      counterObserver.observe(impactSection);
    }

    // ---- Smooth scroll for anchor links ----

      anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault();

          const elementPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset;
          window.scrollTo({
            top: elementPosition - headerOffset,
            behavior: 'smooth'
          });
        }
      });
    });

      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='1'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 720px;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
      padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-4);
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.12);
      border: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xl);
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--red-primary);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse-dot {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; }
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: var(--fs-5xl);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
      line-height: 1.7;
      opacity: 0.9;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-8);
      max-width: 560px;
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* ============================================
       MISSION
    ============================================ */
    .mission {
      padding: var(--sp-20) 0;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
    }

    .mission-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--sp-16);
      align-items: center;
    }

    .mission-label {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--red-primary);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
    }

    .mission h2 {
      font-size: var(--fs-3xl);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .mission-body {
      font-size: var(--fs-base);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .mission-body p + p {
      margin-top: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .mission-image {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-200) 0%, var(--gray-300) 100%);
    }

    .mission-image-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(92% 0.02 245), oklch(88% 0.03 18));
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      text-align: center;
      padding: var(--sp-8);
    }

    .mission-image-placeholder svg {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
      opacity: 0.4;
    }

    /* ============================================
       IMPACT STATS
    ============================================ */
    .impact {
      padding: var(--sp-20) 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, oklch(35% 0.1 245) 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .impact::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%, oklch(50% 0.18 18 / 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .impact-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-16);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .impact-label {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: oklch(80% 0.05 18);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
    }

    .impact h2 {
      font-size: var(--fs-3xl);
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .impact-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: var(--sp-8);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .impact-stat {
      text-align: center;
      padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-4);
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.06);
      border: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base), background var(--transition-base);
    }
    .impact-stat:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
    }

    .impact-number {
      font-size: var(--fs-5xl);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .impact-number .counter-prefix {
      font-size: var(--fs-3xl);
    }

    .impact-unit {
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
      font-weight: 600;
      opacity: 0.9;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
    }

    .impact-desc {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      opacity: 0.7;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .impact-footnote {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: var(--sp-12);
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      opacity: 0.6;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    /* ============================================
       PROGRAMS ACCORDION
    ============================================ */
    .programs {
      padding: var(--sp-20) 0;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-12);
    }

    .section-label {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--red-primary);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
    }

    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: var(--fs-3xl);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .accordion {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .accordion-item {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition-base);
    }
    .accordion-item:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .accordion-trigger {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: var(--sp-5) var(--sp-6);
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy);
      text-align: left;
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .accordion-trigger:hover {
      background: var(--bg-muted);
    }

    .accordion-trigger-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .accordion-icon-circle {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .accordion-icon-circle.red { background: var(--red-surface); }
    .accordion-icon-circle.navy { background: var(--navy-surface); }

    .accordion-chevron {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .accordion-item.active .accordion-chevron {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .accordion-panel {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition-slow), padding var(--transition-slow);
    }
    .accordion-item.active .accordion-panel {
      max-height: 300px;
    }

    .accordion-panel-inner {
      padding: 0 var(--sp-6) var(--sp-6);
      padding-left: calc(40px + var(--sp-4) + var(--sp-6));
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      font-size: var(--fs-base);
    }

    /* ============================================
       GET INVOLVED
    ============================================ */
    .involved {
      padding: var(--sp-20) 0;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
    }

    .involved-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--sp-8);
    }

    .involved-card {
      padding: var(--sp-8);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .involved-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .involved-card-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
      font-size: var(--fs-2xl);
    }
    .involved-card-icon.red { background: var(--red-surface); }
    .involved-card-icon.navy { background: var(--navy-surface); }

    .involved-card h3 {
      font-size: var(--fs-xl);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
    }

    .involved-card p {
      font-size: var(--fs-base);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .involved-card .btn {
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* ============================================
       NEWS CAROUSEL
    ============================================ */
    .news {
      padding: var(--sp-20) 0;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
    }

    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-10);
    }

    .news-nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
    }

    .news-nav-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      background: var(--white);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .news-nav-btn:hover {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--navy);
    }

    .news-track-wrapper {
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--sp-6);
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .news-card {
      min-width: calc(50% - var(--sp-3));
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
    }
    .news-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .news-card-image {
      height: 180px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-200), var(--gray-300));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
    }

    .news-card-body {
      padding: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .news-card-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: var(--sp-1) var(--sp-3);
      background: var(--red-surface);
      color: var(--red-primary);
      font-size: var(--fs-xs);
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
    }

    .news-card h3 {
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .news-card p {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ============================================
       DONATE CTA
    ============================================ */
    .donate-cta {
      padding: var(--sp-20) 0;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
    }

    .donate-cta-inner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red-primary) 0%, oklch(55% 0.2 10) 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xl);
      padding: var(--sp-16);
      color: var(--white);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .donate-cta-inner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .donate-cta-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--sp-12);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .donate-cta-content h2 {
      font-size: var(--fs-4xl);
      font-weight: 900;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .donate-cta-content p {
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
      opacity: 0.9;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .donate-cta-trust {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    .impact-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: separate;
      border-spacing: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .impact-table th {
      text-align: left;
      padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4);
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
    }

    .impact-table td {
      padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4);
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      border-top: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
    }

    .impact-table td:first-child {
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* ============================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: oklch(90% 0.005 245);
      padding: var(--sp-16) 0 var(--sp-8);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--sp-10);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-12);
    }

    .footer-brand {
      max-width: 280px;
    }

    .footer-brand-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-3);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .footer-brand-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--red-primary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: var(--fs-base);
    }

    .footer-brand p {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      line-height: 1.7;
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      padding: var(--sp-1) 0;
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      opacity: 0.6;
      transition: opacity var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .footer-col a:hover {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
      padding-top: var(--sp-8);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .footer-copy {
      font-size: var(--fs-xs);
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .footer-social a {
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: opacity var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .footer-social a:hover {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    /* ============================================
       DONATION MODAL
    ============================================ */
    .modal-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.5);
      z-index: 200;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: var(--sp-6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }
    .modal-overlay.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    .modal {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xl);
      max-width: 520px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      animation: modal-enter 0.3s ease;
    }

    @keyframes modal-enter {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.96);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
      }
    }

    .modal-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: var(--sp-6) var(--sp-8);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }

    .modal-header h2 {
      font-size: var(--fs-xl);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .modal-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .modal-close:hover {
      background: var(--bg-muted);
      color: var(--gray-700);
    }

    .modal-body {
      padding: var(--sp-8);
    }

    .donate-amounts {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--sp-3);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .donate-amount-btn {
      padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-2);
      border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy);
      background: var(--white);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .donate-amount-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
      color: var(--red-primary);
    }
    .donate-amount-btn.selected {
      background: var(--red-primary);
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .donate-amount-btn .amount {
      display: block;
      font-size: var(--fs-xl);
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .donate-amount-btn .amount-impact {
      display: block;
      font-size: var(--fs-xs);
      opacity: 0.7;
      margin-top: var(--sp-1);
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    .donate-custom {
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .donate-custom label {
      display: block;
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
    }

    .donate-custom-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4);
      border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: var(--font-family);
      color: var(--navy);
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .donate-custom-input:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
    }
    .donate-custom-input::placeholder {
      color: var(--gray-300);
    }

    .donate-frequency {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--sp-3);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .freq-btn {
      flex: 1;
      padding: var(--sp-3);
      border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      text-align: center;
      font-size: var(--fs-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      background: var(--white);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .freq-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
      color: var(--red-primary);
    }
    .freq-btn.selected {
      background: var(--red-surface);
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
      color: var(--red-primary);
    }

    .donate-submit {
      width: 100%;
      padding: var(--sp-4);
      font-size: var(--fs-lg);
    }

    .donate-secure {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: var(--sp-4);
      font-size: var(--fs-xs);
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* ============================================
       RESPONSIVE
    ============================================ */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .hero h1 {
        font-size: var(--fs-4xl);
      }

      .impact-stats {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .donate-cta-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      :root {
        --header-height: 64px;
      }

      .header-nav,
      .header-utility {

  <script>
    // ---- Mobile Menu ----
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = mobileDrawer.classList.contains('open');
      if (isOpen) {
        closeMobileMenu();
      } else {
        mobileDrawer.classList.add('open');
        hamburger.classList.add('active');
        hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }
    });

    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileDrawer.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.classList.remove('active');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    // ---- Accordion ----
    function toggleAccordion(trigger) {
      const item = trigger.closest('.accordion-item');
      const isActive = item.classList.contains('active');

      // Close all
      document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.remove('active');
        el.querySelector('.accordion-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });

      // Open clicked if it was closed
      if (!isActive) {
        item.classList.add('active');
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    }

    // ---- News Carousel ----
    let newsIndex = 0;
    const newsTrack = document.getElementById('newsTrack');

    function getCardsPerView() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 1;
      return 2;
    }

    function slideNews(direction) {
      const cards = newsTrack.querySelectorAll('.news-card');
      const perView = getCardsPerView();
      const maxIndex = cards.length - perView;

      newsIndex += direction;
      if (newsIndex < 0) newsIndex = maxIndex;
      if (newsIndex > maxIndex) newsIndex = 0;

      const cardWidth = cards[0].offsetWidth + 24; // 24 = gap
      newsTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${newsIndex * cardWidth}px)`;
    }

    // Recalculate on resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      newsTrack.style.transform = `translateX(0)`;
      newsIndex = 0;
    });

    // ---- Donation Modal ----
    function openDonateModal() {
      document.getElementById('donateModal').classList.add('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeDonateModal() {
      document.getElementById('donateModal').classList.remove('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    // Close modal on overlay click
    document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeDonateModal();
    });

    // Close modal on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeDonateModal();
        closeMobileMenu();
      }
    });

    function selectAmount(btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
      btn.classList.add('selected');
      document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
    }

    function clearAmountSelection() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
    }

    function selectFrequency(btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.freq-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
      btn.classList.add('selected');
    }

    function submitDonation() {
      const selected = document.querySelector('.donate-amount-btn.selected');
      const custom = document.getElementById('customAmount').value;
      const amount = custom || (selected ? selected.dataset.amount : null);
      if (!amount) {
        document.getElementById('customAmount').focus();
        return;
      }
      alert('Thank you for your $' + parseInt(amount).toLocaleString() + ' donation! This is a demo — no payment was processed.');
      closeDonateModal();
    }

    // ---- Animated Counters ----
    function animateCounters() {
      const counters = document.querySelectorAll('[data-target]');
      counters.forEach(counter => {
        if (counter.dataset.animated) return;
        const target = parseInt(counter.dataset.target);
        const suffix = counter.dataset.suffix || '';
        const prefix = counter.dataset.prefix || '';
        const duration = 2000;
        const startTime = performance.now();

        function update(currentTime) {
          const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
          const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
          // Ease out cubic
          const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
          const current = Math.round(eased * target);
          counter.textContent = prefix + current.toLocaleString() + suffix;
          if (progress < 1) {
            requestAnimationFrame(update);
          } else {
            counter.dataset.animated = 'true';
          }
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(update);
      });
    }

    // Intersection Observer for counter animation
    const impactSection = document.getElementById('impact');
    const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCounters();
          counterObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    if (impactSection) {
      counterObserver.observe(impactSection);
    }

    // ---- Smooth scroll for anchor links ----
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const headerOffset = parseInt(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--header-height'));
          const elementPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset;
          window.scrollTo({
            top: elementPosition - headerOffset,
            behavior: 'smooth'
          });
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
